notes:
Mid-market SaaS (helpdesk/chat) evaluating Redwood Hosted API with view to Dedicated later if throughput/cost demands it. Primary ask: production-grade agent that streams tokens to client and supports tool-calling (KB lookup, order status, ticket creation). Strong emphasis on latency: target <1.5s first-token for typical 1KB context; need data on 95th pct and median under realistic concurrency. Quote from CTO on 3/3 call: "streaming is table-stakes — users notice the pause immediately. If first-token >1.5s we lose adoption."

POC notes: non-prod org created, running sample chat workload (mix of short routing questions and longer troubleshooting dialogs). Observed hosted baseline: 1.1s median first-token but 95p ~1.8s on bursts — they want guidance on batching/caching/quantization tradeoffs. Pricing sensitivity: mid (wants predictable monthly commit if Dedicated is needed).

Security: require SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for all API keys, KMS integration for customer keys later. Data residency question for EU customers (some enterprise customers require EU only).

Sales friction: need clear mapping of cost per concurrent agent and fallback policies for throttling/latency SLO breaches. They asked for a sample SLA addendum.

AE notes (Maya): good technical engagement, SE call went well 2026-03-03, Rafael to run 48h POC with streaming telemetry. If metric pass, move to pricing + Dedicated pilot conversation.
